svg.aria-label: Request handlers send commands over channels to one goroutine per timer. Each timer publishes to one event hub goroutine, which sends live updates to every open tab and device.
svg.title: Request handlers send commands over channels to one goroutine per timer. Each timer publishes to one event hub goroutine, which sends live updates to every open tab and device.
svg.text: channels carry every message, so no timer's state is ever shared
